title: MZ Animated Background for Main Menu?

posts.author: Multivitamin
posts.body: So I figured out how to use the 3 MOG Plugins (titlelayers, titleparticles and titlecommands) and got Mogs master demo main menu working on my own. However what I'd like to do is actually replace the background image entirely with an animated picture/gif/video I've made. How would I go about doing that?

posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi there!
I don't know if Mog plugins can or cannot do that.
But, I have a plugin that let you add a spritesheet/picture/parallax on any window and scene background:
Hakuen Studio Background Manager for RPG Maker MZ by Hakuen Studio
Create customized backgrounds for scenes and windows!
hakuenstudio.itch.io
Maybe they are compatible with Mog.
